records.title: Demand for expansion and modernisation of Hyderabad MMTS.
details:
Shri Ravi Chandra Vaddiraju:
I seek to draw the attention of Government to the need
for expansion, modernisation and integration of the Multi-Modal Transport
System (MMTS) in Hyderabad, Telangana. Hyderabad is one of the fastest-growing
metropolitan cities in the country, with a rapidly increasing population and a
significant daily movement of students, employees, workers and business
communities. The existing MMTS provides an affordable and efficient mode of
public transport, but its network remains inadequate in comparison with the
growing requirements of the city. The Government of India has already invested
substantially in the development of Hyderabad?s railway and urban transport
infrastructure. However, several approved and proposed MMTS Phase-II works need
to be completed at the earliest. Better connectivity between MMTS stations and Hyderabad
Metro stations is also essential to create a truly integrated public transport
system. I therefore urge the Government to accord priority to the expansion of
MMTS services, completion of pending works, introduction of additional services
and improvement of station infrastructure. Particular attention may be given to
extending suburban rail connectivity towards rapidly developing areas and IT
corridors, thereby reducing dependence on private vehicles. Strengthening MMTS
will significantly reduce traffic congestion, pollution and travel time while
providing affordable mobility to lakhs of citizens. I therefore also urge the
Government to take immediate and time-bound action for the comprehensive
expansion and modernisation of Hyderabad MMTS.
(ENDS)

records.title: Demand for strengthening Telangana’s industrial belt
details:
Shri Ravi Chandra Vaddiraju:
I draw attention of the Government for the comprehensive development of Bhadradri Kothagudem in
Telangana. This region is not merely a district headquarters; it is a unique
geographical junction connecting Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, and
Odisha. Known as the energy capital of Telangana, it powers the nation through
the historic Singareni Collieries. Despite its
strategic importance, the region lacks the critical infrastructure required to
become a major industrial and logistics hub. I demand the following three
national institutions for Kothagudem (i)?? AIIMS at Kothagudem: This predominantly tribal belt requires
world-class healthcare. Currently, millions of citizens have to travel hundreds
of kilometers to Hyderabad or Raipur for advanced treatment. (ii)Greenfield
Airport: Hosting strategic installations like the Heavy Water Plant and massive
coal industries, the absence of an airport is a significant gap. A local
airport would ensure faster industrial connectivity and vital emergency medical
evacuation. (iii)???????? Railway
Division: With emerging projects like the Kothagudem?Kirandul
and Malkangiri?Bhadrachalam lines, Kothagudem is becoming a massive rail hub for coal and
minerals. Establishing a dedicated Railway Division is now administratively and
economically essential. By sanctioning these projects, the Government can
transform this four-state junction into a powerhouse of tribal welfare,
national security, and industrial growth. I urge the Government to look into
it.
(ENDS)
